title: 设计浏览器历史记录
summary: 实现访问新网址、后退若干步和前进若干步的浏览器历史。访问新网址会丢弃当前页之后的前进历史。
insight: 用列表保存线性历史和 current 下标；visit 时截断 current 之后元素，back/forward 只钳制下标。
pitfalls: 访问新页必须清空前进记录
后退和前进可能超过可用步数
返回移动后的当前网址

solutions.title: 历史列表与游标
solutions.idea: 以数组下标表示当前页面并在新访问时截断尾部。
steps: visit 删除 current 后所有元素，再添加 url 并 current++

code.java: class BrowserHistory { private final List<String> history=new ArrayList<>();private int current=0;public BrowserHistory(String homepage){history.add(homepage);}public void visit(String url){while(history.size()>current+1)history.remove(history.size()-1);history.add(url);current++;}public String back(int steps){current=Math.max(0,current-steps);return history.get(current);}public String forward(int steps){current=Math.min(history.size()-1,current+steps);return history.get(current);} }
code.kotlin: class BrowserHistory(homepage:String){private val history=mutableListOf(homepage);private var current=0;fun visit(url:String){while(history.size>current+1)history.removeAt(history.lastIndex);history.add(url);current++};fun back(steps:Int):String{current=maxOf(0,current-steps);return history[current]};fun forward(steps:Int):String{current=minOf(history.lastIndex,current+steps);return history[current]}}
code.cpp: class BrowserHistory { vector<string> history;int current=0;public:BrowserHistory(string homepage):history{homepage}{}void visit(string url){history.resize(current+1);history.push_back(url);++current;}string back(int steps){current=max(0,current-steps);return history[current];}string forward(int steps){current=min((int)history.size()-1,current+steps);return history[current];} };
